title: Rum-Glazed Algerian Wrap
description: Savor the rich flavors of North Africa in this sweet and savory wrap, topped with a hint of rum-glazed goodness.

ingredients.name: Rum (optional)
ingredients.notes: optional, add a hint of flavor

ingredients.name: Molten Honey
ingredients.notes: or regular honey for a sweeter taste

instructions: Place the Algerian wrap on a baking sheet and toast for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a small saucepan, heat the rum (if using) and molten honey over low heat until warm and fragrant.
Brush the rum-honey glaze over the toasted wrap.
Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the wrap.
Top with chopped fresh mint (if using).
